title.en: Deck boards being laid over the frame

alt.tr: Ayaklı çıtalar üzerine yan yana konan ilk deck tahtaları, yanda istif ve uzatma kablosu
alt.en: First deck boards placed side by side on pedestal-mounted joists, with a stack and an extension cable beside them

caption.tr: Tahtalar kenardan başlanarak sıralanıyor. Kalan tahtalar yan tarafta istiflenmiş, zeminde kablo uzanıyor.
caption.en: Laying starts at the edge. The remaining boards are stacked to the side and a cable runs across the floor.
